findings.consequence: If a pallet jams at the entry (X11 blocked for more than 5.0 seconds while the conveyor is running), the conveyor will not stop and no alarm will be raised. This violates CE-ST10-03, potentially causing mechanical damage or disrupting production flow.
findings.evidence: The program resets the jam alarm flag M190 in R2 and uses it in the fault summary in R3, but M190 is never SET. Furthermore, the entry photo-eye X11 (PE-1002) and the jam timer T10 are completely absent from the program (confirmed by the lint data).
findings.proposed_fix: Add the jam detection timer logic before the fault summary: `LD X11`, `AND Y10`, `OUT T10 K50`. Then add a rung to latch the alarm flag: `LD T10`, `SET M190`.
findings.title: Missing conveyor jam detection logic

data.summary: The ST10 conveyor logic successfully implements the basic motor control, the E-stop and overload interlocks, and the 2.0 s pallet release pulse mechanism. However, the required jam detection logic is entirely absent. The jam alarm flag (M190) is evaluated and able to be reset, but it is never set, and the corresponding photo-eye input (X11) and timer (T10) are unused. Adding the missing timer and latching logic will bring the program into full compliance with the control narrative and the cause-and-effect matrix.
